summary: COSMOTRIX X is an interactive space exploration platform designed to make complex astronomical concepts more accessible and engaging. It brings together two major research topics: NASA’s SPHEREx mission and the scientific hypothesis of Planet X. The platform features dedicated sections for cosmic exploration, time-based discoveries, spectral vision, scientific research, and an AI Cosmic Assistant. By combining interactive visualizations, educational content, and artificial intelligence, COSMOTRIX X helps users explore scientific information, understand astronomical discoveries, and engage with space research in a more intuitive way. The project aims to bridge the gap between complex scientific data and public understanding, transforming space education from passive reading into an engaging digital exploration experience. Its long-term vision is to inspire curiosity, encourage scientific thinking, and make the wonders of the universe more accessible to learners and space enthusiasts.
details: 1. What Does It Do and How Does It Work? COSMOTRIX X is an interactive digital platform designed to make space science and astronomical research more accessible, engaging, and understandable. The platform focuses on two main scientific topics: NASA's SPHEREx mission and the Planet X hypothesis. It organizes the experience into dedicated sections, allowing users to explore astronomical concepts through educational content, visual experiences, and research-based information. Its main sections include Mission Control, Cosmic Sky Explorer, Time-Travel, SkySpectralVision, DiscoveryCenter, SPHEREx Research, Planet X Research, and AI Cosmic Assistant. Each section serves a specific purpose, creating an integrated space exploration experience. 2. Benefits and Expected Impact COSMOTRIX X aims to bridge the gap between complex astronomical research and public understanding. It provides learners and space enthusiasts with an accessible way to discover scientific concepts, explore space-related information, and develop curiosity about the universe. Its expected impact includes encouraging STEM education, supporting independent learning, improving public awareness of astronomical research, and inspiring the next generation of space explorers and researchers. 3. Tools and Technologies The project was developed as a web-based platform using Figma and Figma Make for interface design and development. AI-assisted development tools supported the creation and refinement of the platform. The project combines user interface and experience design (UI/UX), interactive web experiences, artificial intelligence concepts, and scientific information visualization. 4. Creativity and Innovation The creative aspect of COSMOTRIX X lies in bringing multiple space research experiences together in one digital environment instead of presenting isolated scientific articles. Its futuristic Cosmic Glass visual identity, dark navy and electric blue color palette, organized research sections, and AI Cosmic Assistant are designed to create an engaging and intuitive exploration experience. The integration of SPHEREx research with the Planet X hypothesis also creates an opportunity to explore both an active NASA scientific mission and an important open question in planetary science. 5. Factors Considered During Development Our team considered scientific accuracy, accessibility, clarity of information, ease of navigation, visual consistency, educational value, and the distinction between confirmed scientific findings and unconfirmed hypotheses. We also considered how to present complex astronomical information in a way that users with different levels of scientific knowledge could understand and explore. 6. Our Vision COSMOTRIX X aims to transform the way people interact with space science by turning astronomical knowledge into an accessible, interactive, and inspiring digital experience.
